notes: All 10 recorded items pass the energy check (protein*17 + carbs*17 + fat*37 within 3% of energy_kj). Name mappings: the Chobani Fit line is now 'High Protein' on chobani.com.au (the old Fit page redirects to it); the plain tub is '20G Protein Plain' (900g tub, 'less than 0.5% fat'), recorded as the Fit Natural successor. Chobani 'Plain 0.5% fat' is sold as 'Natural Light' (page text says '0.5% fat'), though the panel prints fat 0.2g/100g. Chobani pages print a per-serve column but no serve weight: implied serve about 190g (20G Plain) and 160g (Natural Light), left null. Babybel prints carbohydrate and sugars as '<1 g' per 100g, and Perfect Italiano Parmesan prints sugars as 'Less than 1g'; recorded as null rather than guessing. rokebyfarms.com.au redirects to rokebynutrition.com, which names the products 'Protein Smoothie' (no 'Whole Protein' wording). Rokeby Dutch Chocolate shows exactly the same panel as Double Espresso on the brand site, which may be a copy-paste on their page; treat Dutch Chocolate with caution. Rokeby values are per 100mL; serving_g holds mL (425) for Double Espresso; the Dutch Chocolate page gives no serve size (per-serve values imply about 425mL). Rokeby pages note the packaging panel takes precedence. Milo values are the powder-only per-100g column (the page also shows with-milk columns); the energy row was garbled in the page markup and matched by position, and is consistent with the per-serve 320kJ.
